scope: New generated-input implementation verification, not patient evaluation or a new NIST confirmatory test
historical_evaluation: All old nine NIST tasks remain exposed, unchanged and excluded from tuning and new performance claims

numerics.exact_arithmetic: Python Fraction and fraction-free integer elimination
numerics.soundness_checks: Independent analytic solutions and independently implemented rational oracle; singular, finite, dimensions and input binding
numerics.false_rejection_checks: New anisotropic hand-defined cases, not old NIST tasks; no universal improvement claim

solver_cost_check.input: Fixed integer modular design with an identity block; exact rational response; no data files
solver_cost_check.order: Alternating Fraction-reference then Bareiss, then reverse on successive repetitions
solver_cost_check.interpretation: Common-kernel warm engineering timings, not TACTIC/direct speedup, no exclusive CPU assurance, no independent biological samples
solver_cost_check.stop: On algebraic mismatch or invalid bound, stop; no algorithm/threshold re-selection using results

release_gate: All implementation tests and independent automatic code review pass; sanitized allowlist manifest; preserve negative findings; functional gate is not performance or clinical validation
publication_boundary: No claim of NC readiness, new visual-model architecture, first-ever certificate method, or controller superiority
publishing: Only clean synthetic research-code subtree on a new shumao469/stroke branch; do not modify main, copy old runtime, restricted datasets, credentials or weights
